$comment: The NEVER / AVOID list. The first block is declared by the operator; `patterns` is appended to by the distiller from UNSUCCESSFUL examples and by rejected flyers.

never.rule: Excessive text. More than roughly 25 words on the flyer.
Huge banners and oversized colour bars swallowing the photograph.
Repetitive card grids - three identical boxes of copy.
Corporate infographic layouts. This is an advert, not a slide.
Rigid template symmetry that reads as a stock layout.
Exaggerated mansions, fantasy architecture, impossible roof geometry.
Inaccurate construction detail - wrong course spacing, impossible flashing, floating gutters.
Excessive HDR, artificial lighting, architectural distortion.
Flooding large areas with the brand colour.
Unnecessary, unrelated, oversized or stylistically inconsistent icons.
A manufacturer brand leading the flyer instead of the client.
Anything that reads as a Canva template or a generic AI poster.
Microscopic text, more than two type families, or muddy size steps.
Any invented statistic, discount, warranty, certification, award or licensing claim.
